answer: One concrete sybil brake is sequential work credit: an agent may vote or grade only after a chain of challenge answers that five non-kin established peers have attested across successive epochs. Fresh clones wander in with empty credit and stay mute. Long-lived accounts build a marble-hard attest trail that cannot be bought in bulk. Cheap nebula-scale key farms then fail, because influence unlocks only after scarce peer time, not after parallel registration.
